title: Storm Boelo Brings Strong Winds and Heavy Rain to the UK
subtitle: Travel plans are cancelled and thousands of homes face power cuts as the second storm of the season hits.

summary.en: The United Kingdom is facing severe weather as Storm Boelo arrives following Storm Austen. The Met Office has issued amber weather warnings for high winds across Scotland, Northern Ireland, and northern England. Many flights have been cancelled, and travel across the country is seeing significant delays. Experts are warning the public to stay indoors due to the danger of flying debris and flooding. Power companies are working hard to restore electricity to homes that lost power during the recent storms.
summary.zh: 英國在奧斯汀風暴後又迎來波洛風暴，正面臨惡劣天氣的侵襲。英國氣象局已針對蘇格蘭、北愛爾蘭與英格蘭北部發布強風琥珀色警報。許多航班已被取消，全國各地的交通也出現嚴重延誤。專家警告民眾，由於飛散碎片與洪水帶來的危險，應盡量待在室內。電力公司正努力為近期風暴中停電的家庭恢復供電。

paragraphs.en: The United Kingdom is currently dealing with the effects of Storm Boelo, the second named storm of the season. This weather event has brought strong winds and heavy rain, causing widespread disruption to travel and daily life. The storm arrived shortly after Storm Austen, which hit parts of the country on Friday, leaving many areas already struggling with the impact of severe weather.
paragraphs.zh: 英國目前正應對「波洛風暴」(Storm Boelo) 所帶來的影響，這是本季第二個被命名的風暴。這場氣象事件帶來了強風與豪雨，導致交通與日常生活受到廣泛干擾。該風暴在「奧斯汀風暴」(Storm Austen) 之後不久便抵達，後者於週五襲擊了該國部分地區，使得許多區域早已在艱難應對惡劣天氣的衝擊。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, the Met Office has issued amber weather warnings—the second most serious level of alert—for parts of Scotland, Northern Ireland, and the far north of England. These warnings mean that the weather could cause significant problems, including danger to life from flying debris and large, crashing waves. The Met Office expects wind speeds to reach between 60 and 70 mph, with some coastal areas potentially seeing gusts as high as 80 mph.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》(The Guardian) 報導，英國氣象局 (Met Office) 已針對蘇格蘭、北愛爾蘭及英格蘭極北地區發布了琥珀色天氣警報，這是嚴重程度第二高的警戒級別。這些警報意味著天氣可能引發重大問題，包括飛散碎片與巨浪所帶來的生命危險。氣象局預計風速將達到每小時 60 到 70 英里，部分沿海地區的陣風時速甚至可能高達 80 英里。

paragraphs.en: Jason Kelly, the chief forecaster at the Met Office, explained that the strongest winds and the most serious problems will likely happen in the north. He noted that while the amber warnings cover specific areas, other parts of the UK will also feel the effects of the storm. “People should prepare for the potential for disruption, particularly to travel and power supplies,” Kelly said. He advised the public to secure loose items outside their homes and to keep checking the latest weather reports before planning any journeys.
paragraphs.zh: 英國氣象局首席預報員凱利 (Jason Kelly) 解釋說，最強勁的風勢與最嚴重的問題可能會出現在北部。他指出，雖然琥珀色警報涵蓋了特定區域，但英國其他地區也會感受到風暴的影響。凱利表示：「民眾應為可能發生的干擾做好準備，特別是在交通與電力供應方面。」他建議大眾固定住家戶外的鬆散物品，並在規劃任何行程前持續查看最新的天氣預報。

paragraphs.en: Travel has already been hit hard by the storm. At Dublin airport, airlines were forced to cancel 19 flights by Saturday afternoon due to the dangerous conditions. Some planes even had to perform “go-arounds,” which is when a pilot decides not to land and circles back to try again, because the wind made landing too difficult. In some cases, planes had to fly to different airports entirely to land safely. On the ground, rail services have also faced issues, with Network Rail reporting that objects like trampolines have been blown onto tracks, creating dangerous situations for trains.
paragraphs.zh: 交通運輸已受到風暴的嚴重打擊。在都柏林機場，由於危險的天氣狀況，航空公司被迫在週六下午取消了 19 個航班。有些飛機甚至必須執行「重飛」，也就是飛行員因風勢過大導致降落困難，決定放棄降落並盤旋後再次嘗試。在某些情況下，飛機甚至必須完全轉降至其他機場才能安全著陸。在地面交通方面，鐵路服務也面臨問題，英國鐵路網公司 (Network Rail) 回報稱，有彈跳床等物體被吹落至軌道上，對火車行駛造成了危險。

paragraphs.en: Flooding is another major concern. The Environment Agency has issued many alerts for areas across England where flooding is possible. By Saturday evening, there were 12 active warnings stating that flooding was expected, meaning residents in those areas needed to take immediate action to protect their property. Heavy rain has been falling since early Saturday morning, with high rainfall totals recorded in places like White Barrow in Wiltshire and parts of North Wales and Scotland.
paragraphs.zh: 洪水是另一個主要隱憂。環境署 (Environment Agency) 已針對英格蘭各地可能發生洪水的地區發布了多項警報。截至週六晚間，共有 12 項現行警告指出預計會發生洪水，這意味著這些地區的居民需要立即採取行動以保護財產。豪雨自週六清晨起便持續不斷，威爾特郡 (Wiltshire) 的懷特巴羅 (White Barrow) 以及北威爾斯與蘇格蘭的部分地區都記錄到了極高的降雨量。

paragraphs.en: For many people, the biggest challenge is the loss of electricity. Storm Austen, which came just before Boelo, caused power cuts for thousands of homes in south-west England. The National Grid worked through the weekend to restore power, successfully returning electricity to over 130,000 properties by Saturday evening. However, with the arrival of the second storm, there are fears that more homes could lose power as lines are damaged by the wind and falling trees.
paragraphs.zh: 對許多人而言，最大的挑戰是電力中斷。在波洛風暴之前抵達的奧斯汀風暴，已導致英格蘭西南部數千戶家庭停電。國家電網 (National Grid) 在週末期間持續搶修，截至週六晚間已成功恢復超過 13 萬戶的電力。然而，隨著第二場風暴的到來，人們擔心由於強風與倒塌樹木損壞電線，可能會有更多家庭面臨停電。

paragraphs.en: As the country waits for the storm to pass, officials are urging everyone to be careful. The Met Office has advised people to stay indoors as much as possible until the weather improves. With the storm expected to continue through Sunday, the focus remains on safety and the repair of essential services. For now, the combination of wind, rain, and the risk of flooding means that the UK will remain in a state of high alert for the rest of the weekend.
paragraphs.zh: 在全國等待風暴過境之際，官員呼籲所有人務必小心。英國氣象局建議民眾在天氣好轉前盡量待在室內。由於預計風暴將持續至週日，目前的重點仍放在安全維護與基礎設施的修復上。就目前而言，強風、豪雨與洪水風險的綜合影響，意味著英國在週末剩餘時間內將持續保持高度警戒。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To be severely affected or damaged by something.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡的 hit 是過去分詞，形容受災嚴重。文中：Travel has already been hit hard by the storm.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A maneuver in which a pilot decides not to land and circles back to try again.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 重飛（指飛機在降落過程中因故放棄，重新爬升盤旋再嘗試降落）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是航空專業術語，但在文中被引號標出並解釋，容易被誤認為普通短語。文中：Some planes even had to perform “go-arounds,” which is when a pilot decides not to land and circles back to try again, because the wind made landing too difficult.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To fix something firmly in place so that it does not move or fall.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作形容詞（安全的），這裡作動詞用，指加固物品以防被風吹走。文中：He advised the public to secure loose items outside their homes and to keep checking the latest weather reports before planning any journeys.

常見指「活躍的」，這裡指警告處於「生效中」的狀態。文中：By Saturday evening, there were 12 active warnings stating that flooding was expected, meaning residents in those areas needed to take immediate action to protect their property.

quiz.question: According to the article, what is the primary reason for the 'go-arounds' performed by airplanes at Dublin airport?

options.A: A lack of available runways due to flooding.
options.B: Dangerous wind conditions making landing difficult.
options.C: Technical failures reported by the aircraft pilots.
options.D: Heavy rain reducing visibility for the landing crew.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第四段，文中明確提到飛行員執行「重飛」（go-arounds）是因為風勢過大，導致降落變得太困難。選項 A 錯誤，文中並未提到機場跑道因淹水而關閉。選項 C 錯誤，文中指出是風力因素而非機械故障。選項 D 雖然提到降雨，但文章強調的是風力對降落造成的直接困難，而非能見度問題。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the impact of the back-to-back storms (Austen and Boelo) on the UK's infrastructure?

options.A: The storms have primarily affected the southern regions of the UK.
options.B: The second storm is expected to cause less damage than the first.
options.C: The cumulative effect of the storms has left the country more vulnerable to further disruption.
options.D: The National Grid has successfully prevented all power outages during the storms.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章提到 Storm Austen 已經讓許多區域疲於應付，而隨後而來的 Storm Boelo 讓這些區域面臨電力線路受損與淹水的風險，顯示連續的災害削弱了基礎設施的韌性。選項 A 錯誤，文中提到北部與蘇格蘭也有嚴重警報。選項 B 錯誤，文章並未暗示第二個風暴威力較弱，反而提到人們擔心電力供應會進一步受損。選項 D 錯誤，文中提到已有 13 萬戶停電，顯然並未成功預防所有停電。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the word 'hit' mean in the phrase 'Travel has already been hit hard by the storm'?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此語境下，「hit hard」是一個慣用語，意指「受到嚴重影響或打擊」。文章隨後列舉了航班取消與鐵路受阻的例子，證實了交通系統運作困難。選項 A 是「hit」的字面意思，但在這裡不合理。選項 C 與文章意旨完全相反。選項 D 完全曲解了該詞在描述交通中斷時的負面語氣。

quiz.question: Which of the following best summarizes the main message of the article?

options.A: A detailed analysis of how the Met Office predicts wind speeds.
options.B: A report on the specific repair costs caused by Storm Boelo.
options.C: An overview of the widespread disruptions and safety risks caused by the recent storms in the UK.
options.D: A guide on how to protect property from flooding and power outages.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文的核心在於描述 Storm Boelo 如何與先前的 Storm Austen 共同造成英國交通混亂、淹水警報、停電危機以及對民眾安全的威脅。選項 A 錯誤，文章僅提到氣象局的預測，並非分析預測方法。選項 B 錯誤，文中完全未提及維修成本。選項 D 錯誤，雖然文中有提到防護建議，但那只是文章的一小部分，並非全文的主旨。
